{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
conversion_rate_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Print the exact value to ensure it's captured
print(conversion_rate_loyal)"}
